_comment: Single source of truth for paths deliberately NOT localized. Consumed by the i18n CI guards (KZ-602) and any rg/pseudo-locale wrapper — do not hardcode these globs anywhere else. Everything here stays ru-only: no t()/<Trans>, Cyrillic string literals are expected.

files.reason: REPORT_SECTIONS[].label is a ru-only string kept solely for the ru-only AdminFeedbackPage; the user-facing form uses REPORT_SECTIONS[].labelKey via t(). See KZ-206 / docs/i18n.md.

HOLLAND_TYPE_LABELS / BIGFIVE_DOMAIN_LABELS / MI_TYPE_LABELS / MOTIVATION_CATEGORY_LABELS / QUESTION_KEYED_LABELS — consumed only by src/pages/admin/** (question-bank admin tables & print reports), ru-only by KZ-210.
GOAL_LABELS / STATUS_LABELS — consumed only by src/pages/admin/** (user list/detail & print reports), ru-only by KZ-210.
Admin edit-form hook (default error copy) — used only by src/pages/admin/** detail pages, ru-only by KZ-210.
beforeunload guard message — used only by AdminProgramDetailPage / useAdminForm, ru-only by KZ-210.

comments.src/pages/admin/**: Admin panel — internal team tool, ru-only by decision (KZ-210).
comments.src/pages/psychologist/**: Psychologist cabinet (pro-281/PRO-327 and PRO-338's Ф0.4 report screen) — internal specialist tool, same ru-only convention as /admin/*; was already unlocalized pre-existing, just missing from this list.
comments.src/pages/assessment/astur/**: Astur assessment subtests — localization in progress in PRO-338.
comments.src/pages/assessment/belbin/**: Belbin assessment — localization in progress in PRO-338.
comments.src/pages/results/components/psych/**: The psych-block "Дополнительно для специалиста" section (validity/MC-SDS + psychoemotional/МЦВ) rendered inside ResultsReportBody. Server-gated to psychologist/admin viewers only (report_service.psych_sections_for) — a student's own /result never receives this data, so these components never render for a student regardless of locale. Dense clinical/psychometric terminology (MC-SDS, LongString, IRV, СО/ВК); ru-only by the same staff-tool reasoning as /admin and /psychologist.
comments.src/shared/ui/admin/**: Admin-only UI primitives (RoleBadge, ChangeLogTable, AdminSectionHeading, RoleGatedAction, density).
comments.src/shared/ui/layouts/AdminLayout.tsx: Admin shell nav labels («Пользователи», «Фидбэк») — chrome for /admin/* only.
comments.src/shared/lib/adminRole.ts: ADMIN_ROLE_LABELS / ADMIN_ROLE_DESCRIPTIONS / REQUIRES_ADMIN_TOOLTIP — role wording shown only in /admin/*.
